mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dream(id, user_id, time, place, emotion, content, interpretation, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{time}, #{place}, #{emotion}, #{content}, #{interpretation}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, time, place, emotion, content, interpretation, created_at as createdAt FROM dream where id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id as userId, time, place, emotion, content, interpretation, created_at as createdAt FROM dream WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
